text:
Alex L: FYI staging canary for checkpoint-2026-03-15 (v2.9) started showing p99 token latency +160ms since 02:10 UTC. CI perf test `staging-p99` failed (~35% regression).
Alex L: Saw spike coincident with onboard rollout at 02:05, no other infra alerts. Rolling out to 10%.
perf-bot: CI: staging-p99 test FAILED — wall_time increased from 120ms -> 162ms (35%) — job id ci/12345 — logs: https://ci/reports/12345
Maria S: I'm grabbing a perf recording. Can someone run `./bin/runtime-prof --since 02:00 --span 15m --tags=kvcache,kernel` on the canary host?
Kevin G: ran quick sample, attaching snippets:
```
kvcache.evictions_per_min: 520
kvcache.miss_rate: 0.78
runtime.kernel_selector: fallback_slow_path
kernel.latency_p50: 6ms
kernel.latency_p99: 142ms
```
Kevin G: Looks like tokenizer change in this checkpoint added a leading-space normalization, causing input prefixes to change; our KV keys are not normalizing canonical tokens so cache locality dropped.
Tanvi R: Also seeing `runtime.kernel.selected=fallback_slow_path` in traces — selector picked fallback due to higher seq-length variance after tokenization drift. That explains kernel latencies + kv churn.
Maria S: profiler flame snippet:
```
[flame] hot: kvcache::retrieve -> copy_key -> hash_str
hotpath: 48% cpu
```
Alex L: Recommendation: pause canary and revert checkpoint rollout. We should also patch tokenizer shim OR canonicalize keys in kvcache. Any objections?
Tanvi R: +1 pause. I'll open a revert PR and add gating metric for kvcache.evictions_per_min < 100 and kernel_selector != fallback_slow_path before auto-rollout.
Kevin G: I'll prototype a quick key-normalization shim that lowercases/trims tokens before hashing. If rollout unblocked we can gray-deploy.
Maria S: Action items: 1) @Tanvi open revert PR (blocking), 2) @Kevin prototype shim + test, 3) I'll add a perf regression CI check to fail builds that increase staging-p99 by >10%.
Alex L: OK pausing canary now, marking rollout as blocked. Thanks all :pray:
perf-bot: Deploy paused: canary checkpoint-2026-03-15 -> rollback requested by Alex L
